method: Serial public API requests. First 300 SHA256(qcc-900-v1:username)-ordered members of chessdojo with 30+ rapid games and current rapid 750-1100; up to six rated standard rapid games per account from their last three archives, both game ratings 800-1000, at least 50 plies. Stop after 48 games. First eligible games in archive order. No move-quality filtering. Complete games alternate tuning/validation. Fixed plies 12,25,38,49.
